description: RCFL is a dataset of 735 expert-labeled periapical radiographs of root canal fillings collected from third-year dental students' preclinical procedures for developing and evaluating automated assessment of filling-length acceptability.
title: RCFL dataset

description: RCFLA-YOLO is the authors' YOLOv11-based software framework for automatically classifying root canal filling length as acceptable or unacceptable in periapical radiographs.
title: RCFLA-YOLO

description: RCT-YES is a free, Institute of Education Sciences-funded software package that implements design-based methods for estimating impacts in randomized controlled trials and related experimental and non-experimental designs.
title: RCT-YES
